Course Completion Tasks

Course Tasks As a new JAGGAER employee or a participant in the JAGGAER Indirect Configuration Certification Program, you are likely taking this course via self -paced eLearning. The following task list covers what we’ll do in the four classes that make up this course. Keep track of what you’ve been able to complete!
JI-PLT-2101 (JAGGAER Indirect Basics)

o Understand use of JAGGAER University and the certification curriculum resources o As an internal user, explore the World Market training site of our demo client, World W ide Widgets o Study the elements of your User Profile o In the JSN : As a supplier, navigate the JAGGAER Supplier Network Portal o In the JSN : As a supplier, navigate a Customer Branded Portal o Locate Online Searchable Help, In -Context Help other forms of assistance within the application
JI-PLT-2201 ("Upstream” Solutions)

o SPEND ANALYTICS : One-Minute Synopsis: JAGGAER Indirect Spend Analytics o SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT : Explore the Supplier Management Dashboard and icon/tabs o SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT : Conduct supplier searches and examine your assigned supplier's profile o SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT : Log into the Supplier Portal as your supplier; add Corporate and Sales contacts o SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT : One-Min ute Synopsis: JAGGAER Indirect Supplier Management

o SOURCING : Explore the Sourcing Dashboard and icon/tabs o SOURCING : Search for sourcing events o SOURCING : Create an RFx (individual and/or group activity) o SOURCING : Respond to the instructor’s event as your assigned supplier o SOURCING : As a team, c reate a scenario for awarding the instructor’s event o SOURCING : One -Minute Synopsis: JAGGAER Indirect Sourcing

JI-PLT-2203 (JAGGAER Indirect Indirect Admin/Config Essentials)

Because we cannot grant admin istrative permissions for our training site to scores of self -paced learners at the same time, the following activities are mostly demo -only. You should complete those with open circles.
• JI ADMINISTRATION : Observe editing a user ’s profile o JI ADMINISTRATION : Create a new Personal Dashboard
• JI ADMINISTRATION : Observe a simple user search and export
• JI ADMINISTRATION : Observe the Administrator icon and tabs o JI ADMINISTRATION : Explore the Product Release Library
• JI CONFIGURATION : Observe editing a Color Theme
• JI CONFIGURATION : Become familiar with General Site Settings
• JI CONFIGURATION : Understand the concept of Work Groups
• JI CONFIGURATION : Study O rg Structure and Settings subtabs o JI CONFIGURATION : Examine your own user's profile, focusing on role s, permissions , and notifications
• JI CONFIGURATION : Observe an overview of Document configuration o JI CONFIGURATION : View workflow from within a Requisition
• JI CONFIGURATION : View Requisition Workflow Setup options; watch as we export and examine the XML
o Make sure you know how to access the JI-PLT -2100 resources in JAGGAER University and complete the end-of-course assessment !
